title: Self-Evolving Agentic Workflows via Semantic Decomposition of Complex Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.01840v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic workflows organize complex tasks into reusable procedures. However, invoking an LLM at every step incurs repeated inference costs and delays. We propose a framework for self-evolving agentic workflows through semantic task decomposition. Each subtask has explicit applicability conditions and a procedure that executes code or invokes a model as needed. An agent uses execution feedback to refine the decomposition and update these procedures. Experiments in the GLEE competition show the framework on bargaining, negotiation and persuasion. Most observed final-decision procedures are implemented in code. Code is available at https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/NeurIPS2026_SeaFlow.

translated_title: 通过复杂任务的语义分解实现自演化的智能体工作流
translated_abstract: 智能体工作流将复杂任务组织成可复用的流程。然而，在每一步都调用大语言模型（LLM）会产生重复的推理成本和延迟。我们提出了一个通过语义任务分解实现自演化智能体工作流的框架。每个子任务都具有明确的适用条件以及相应的执行流程，可根据需要执行代码或调用模型。智能体利用执行反馈来优化任务分解并更新这些流程。在GLEE竞赛中的实验展示了该框架在讨价还价、谈判和说服任务上的表现。大多数观察到的最终决策流程都是用代码实现的。代码可在 https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/NeurIPS2026_SeaFlow 获取。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个通过语义任务分解实现智能体工作流自演化的框架，智能体利用执行反馈不断优化任务分解并更新子任务流程，其中大多数最终决策流程由代码而非大语言模型实现，从而显著降低了重复推理的成本与延迟。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework for self-evolving agentic workflows via semantic task decomposition, where an agent leverages execution feedback to refine task decompositions and update subtask procedures—with most final-decision procedures implemented in code—thereby significantly reducing repeated LLM inference costs and latency.
